```php
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Livewire\Component;

class RoleForm extends Component
{
    public $role = [
        'name' => '',
        'description' => '',
    ];

    public function save()
    {
        // Handle saving the role to the database or storage service
        Auth::user()->roles()->create($this->role);
        session()->flash('success', 'Role created successfully.');
        return redirect()->route('roles.index');
    }

    public function delete()
    {
        // Handle deleting the role from the database or storage service
        $role = Auth::user()->roles()->find($this->role['id']);
        if ($role) {
            $role->delete();
            session()->flash('success', 'Role deleted successfully.');
            return redirect()->route('roles.index');
        }
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.role-form');
    }
}
```
